name: 30056-longthinkjson-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one engine process on one GPU, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=20, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 100 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 30056.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 7000 prompt tokens and 3000 output tokens with min == max, so every request is the same size and nothing stops early. Every request also carries the JSON schema, the blocked `</think>` string and the inline chat template declared in `scenario.json`.
purpose: A long-form reasoning assistant producing schema-constrained JSON answers from 7000-token prompts for 20 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine launch config for 30056-longthinkjson-8b-1gpu. The engine itself is a source checkout
# named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`; interpreter and hardware live in that file.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

reasoning-parser: deepseek_r1

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 12288
enable-prefix-caching: true

# Load-bearing, not "the default": at a 2048-token batch each 7000-token prefill is split into
# four chunks, which changes the step structure of the whole run.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
